newsitem.title: UK: UK Labour to consider extending capital allowances.
newsitem.headline: UK Labour to consider extending capital allowances.

text.p: Labour's economics spokesman, Gordon Brown, said Labour would examine ways of using Britian's tax system to encourage investment if it wins the coming election.
In a major speech on economic policy, Brown said a Labour government would review its previously proposed option of extending capital allowances for investment.

He said Labour was also interested in the Confederation of British Industry's proposal for a two-tier capital gains tax as a means of addressing the dearth of long-term investment in the British economy.
"Our corporate tax review is investigating how the tax system can encourage investment for the long-term and its work will continue into government," Brown said.
